Why choose Free AI Image?

Create an original image, rework a photo, or fix the details. Bring image generation and everyday editing together with tools for each part of the job.

Turn your ideas into original images

Generate images around the subject, setting, lighting, and style you have in mind. Explore a specific visual direction instead of searching for a stock photo that almost fits.

Edit photos with everyday language

Change a photo’s setting, colors, or visual style with written instructions. Use your existing image as the starting point to explore a new version without rebuilding the whole scene.

Separate the subject from its background

Remove the background to create a transparent cutout. Reuse the subject in a new layout or place it against a different backdrop without tracing the outline by hand.

Erase distractions from the scene

Remove unwanted objects and fill the selected area using the surrounding image. Clean up a distracting detail while keeping the framing that made the photo worth keeping.

Make small images larger and clearer

Upscale images to increase resolution and enhance detail. Give a small source image more room in your design when a simple resize leaves it looking soft.

Expand the scene beyond the frame

Generate new image content beyond the original edges. Add space around your subject for a wider composition or a different format without cropping away the parts you want to keep.

Three steps, from idea to download.

Describe your image

Write what you want to see. Include a subject and a style; add a image if you want to edit an existing photo.

Choose your shape

Pick a square, portrait, or landscape shape to suit where you plan to use the image.

Generate and download

Click Generate and complete a browser check if prompted. When the image is ready, download it or refine your prompt and try again.

FAQs about Free AI Image Generator

What is Free AI Image Generator?

Free AI Image Generator creates images from written descriptions and uploaded photos. Use it to turn an idea into a visual or give an existing image a new look.

What is the best AI image generator?

The best choice depends on what you want to create and how much control you need. Free AI Image Generator is a good fit for straightforward text-to-image and photo-based creation with free downloads.

Is Free AI Image Generator free to use?

Yes. You can generate and download images with the free model without spending Credits.

What can I use Free AI Image Generator for?

Use it for social graphics, blog illustrations, product concepts, characters, and moodboards. Describe the scene and style you want to explore.

How do I use Free AI Image Generator?

Upload a photo, describe your changes, choose an aspect ratio, and generate. For a prompt without a photo, open Free AI Text To Image Generator. Review the result and download the version you want to keep.

What image formats and file sizes does Free AI Image Generator support?

Image-to-image generation accepts up to four PNG, JPG, or WebP images, each up to 10MB, together with your written instructions. Text-to-image generation only needs a prompt.

Do I need to sign in to use Free AI Image Generator?

No. You can use the free generator without creating an account.

Can I generate images from both text and photos?

Yes. Start with a written prompt in Text To Image, or upload a photo and describe your changes in Image To Image. Both support square, portrait, and landscape compositions.

What should I check in the generated image?

Inspect the subject, composition, faces, hands, and any lettering at full size. For photo-based edits, compare important details with the original before downloading.

Are there any limits on how many images I can generate?

Yes. Free generation is subject to usage limits, and each request produces one image. Finish one generation before starting the next; follow any limit message shown in the workspace.

Put your next idea into the picture.

A few words. A new direction. Start with the free image generator and see where your idea takes you.

Why choose Free AI Image?

Create an original image, rework a photo, or fix the details. Bring image generation and everyday editing together with tools for each part of the job.

Turn your ideas into original images

Generate images around the subject, setting, lighting, and style you have in mind. Explore a specific visual direction instead of searching for a stock photo that almost fits.

Edit photos with everyday language

Change a photo’s setting, colors, or visual style with written instructions. Use your existing image as the starting point to explore a new version without rebuilding the whole scene.

Separate the subject from its background

Remove the background to create a transparent cutout. Reuse the subject in a new layout or place it against a different backdrop without tracing the outline by hand.

Erase distractions from the scene

Remove unwanted objects and fill the selected area using the surrounding image. Clean up a distracting detail while keeping the framing that made the photo worth keeping.

Make small images larger and clearer

Upscale images to increase resolution and enhance detail. Give a small source image more room in your design when a simple resize leaves it looking soft.

Expand the scene beyond the frame

Generate new image content beyond the original edges. Add space around your subject for a wider composition or a different format without cropping away the parts you want to keep.

Three steps, from idea to download.

Describe your image

Write what you want to see. Include a subject and a style; add a image if you want to edit an existing photo.

Choose your shape

Pick a square, portrait, or landscape shape to suit where you plan to use the image.

Generate and download

Click Generate and complete a browser check if prompted. When the image is ready, download it or refine your prompt and try again.

FAQs about Free AI Image Generator

What is Free AI Image Generator?

Free AI Image Generator creates images from written descriptions and uploaded photos. Use it to turn an idea into a visual or give an existing image a new look.

What is the best AI image generator?

The best choice depends on what you want to create and how much control you need. Free AI Image Generator is a good fit for straightforward text-to-image and photo-based creation with free downloads.

Is Free AI Image Generator free to use?

是的。 You can generate and download images with the free model without spending Credits.

What can I use Free AI Image Generator for?

Use it for social graphics, blog illustrations, product concepts, characters, and moodboards. Describe the scene and style you want to explore.

How do I use Free AI Image Generator?

Upload a photo, describe your changes, choose an aspect ratio, and generate. For a prompt without a photo, open Free AI Text To Image Generator. Review the result and download the version you want to keep.

What image formats and file sizes does Free AI Image Generator support?

Image-to-image generation accepts up to four PNG, JPG, or WebP images, each up to 10MB, together with your written instructions. Text-to-image generation only needs a prompt.

Do I need to sign in to use Free AI Image Generator?

No. You can use the free generator without creating an account.

Can I generate images from both text and photos?

是的。 Start with a written prompt in Text To Image, or upload a photo and describe your changes in Image To Image. Both support square, portrait, and landscape compositions.

What should I check in the generated image?

Inspect the subject, composition, faces, hands, and any lettering at full size. For photo-based edits, compare important details with the original before downloading.

Are there any limits on how many images I can generate?
